prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1463; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd prefer to keep my name off the recording for now, but you have my claim file. Go ahead with your questions.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?

A: It was at a four-way intersection in League City, Texas. Traffic lights were working, I believe.

Q: What direction were you traveling when the collision occurred?

A: I was heading east through the intersection, and the other vehicle came from the north side and entered my lane.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before impact?

A: Only a moment before. I tried to brake, but there wasn't enough time. It hit the driver's side of my car.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was. The airbags deployed, and I got thrown against the door and the steering wheel.

Q: Did you receive medical attention?

A: The paramedics took me to the emergency room. They X-rayed my left wrist and told me it was fractured. I'm wearing a splint now and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic specialist next week.

Q: Has a doctor said how long recovery will take?

A: They mentioned several weeks in the splint, and possibly physical therapy afterward. I can't work my usual shifts right now because I use that hand a lot.

Q: Did anyone else in your vehicle get hurt?

A: No, I was alone in the car.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I was driving carefully and following the signal. I'd like this handled as quickly as possible.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
